title: HubSignal
description: Conceptual envelope for every server-to-client SignalR event on a Sorcha notification hub. Hub method signatures take individual typed parameters matching this shape; this schema validates the conceptual envelope, not the literal wire payload.

EventType.description: PascalCase event type name. Must match the typed-client method name exactly.

Ids.description: Opaque identifiers carried by this event. No claim values, no descriptions, no balances. Each ID must be resolvable via an authenticated REST detail endpoint.

OccurredAt.description: Server-side timestamp at which the event occurred.

TraceId.description: W3C trace-id (32 hex chars) or trace-id and parent span (32-16 with hyphen). Used to correlate the event across origin service, Redis backplane, and client receipt.
